svg.title: Planit Stage 2 — Strategy, Adapter and external tools

g.text: Planit Stage 2 — Strategy, Adapter and external tools
Strategy supplies prompt guidance, not a guaranteed optimizer.
Facade invokes tools; agent receives provider context.
No tools list, autonomous tool dispatch or agent memory map.
Dashed line and hollow triangle: interface realization.
Solid arrow: retained association; dashed arrow: temporary dependency.
SDK / HTTP internals and AutoCloseable realizations omitted.
